text:
anya: Quick ask — can we lock a 30m slot next week for a perf rundown? Looking for readouts on latency/cost dashboards and the new KV-cache patch. Proposed agenda: 1) benchmark readout (end-to-end) 2) cost tradeoffs for batching/quant 3) rollout plan + canaries 4) open triage. Prefer Tue/Wed mornings. Who's in?

raj: I can do Tue 10:30-11:00 PT (should give us the 30m).

matt: Wed morning better for me, but I can shift to Tue if that's the consensus.

sophia: +1 for Tue. Please include the latest flamegraphs — https://redwood/dashboard/perf/kv-patch (the CPU spike is visible).

lee: Can we add a quick check of embedding timeouts? Saw a regression in the staging run on 2026-02-28. Also add "eval set runbook" to the agenda.

anya: Good catch, adding eval runbook and embedding timeout check. matt — can you prep the cost calc table? Ideally show tokens/sec vs $/k token for the batch/quant combos.

matt: Yep. I'll prepare numbers. Quick note on how I run the job: `./run_bench --model=redwood-v1 --batch=8 --seq=1024 --warmup=3 --runs=50` — will include the script and raw csv.

benchmark-bot: Automated note — latest benchmark finished 1802499000. Summary: p50=85ms, p95=230ms, avg tokens/sec=18. See /bench/1802499000 for logs and flamegraphs.

raj: Quick Q — should we include int8 and int4 variants in the readout? I can kick off int8 runs today; int4 takes a bit more tuning.

anya: Yes include int8 + int4 if possible. If int4 is flaky, call it out with the failure modes. Also please annotate which runs used KV cache vs cold-start.

sophia: Can we timebox the agenda? 10m bench, 10m cost tradeoffs, 5m rollout/canaries, 5m open triage — keep it tight. :+1:

matt: Booked Tue 10:30 PT on my calendar. I'll upload the cost sheet before EOD Monday and attach the run scripts.

lee: Works for me. If anyone needs infra creds for the int8 jobs ping infra-oncall and I'll get you access. :thumbsup:

anya: Great — locking Tue 10:30 PT. Pre-reads to upload: bench snapshot + flamegraphs + cost calc. Thanks all.

raj: I'll start int8 runs tonight and post results in this thread.

matt: If you want a quick comparison table, use this snippet to aggregate csvs:

```bash
python tools/aggregate_bench.py --inputs=run_*.csv --out=summary.md
```

sophia: Thanks — will skim pre-reads before the meeting and add notes inline.

anya: Perfect. If anyone has any blockers getting the numbers ready, drop them here and we'll handle async. Otherwise see you Tue.

(Reaction: :eyes: from sophia)
